# Quality rules and the checks that enforce them

Every defect the owner found becomes a **rule** and, where possible, an **automated check**.
Before every merge into `claude/foundation`:

1. Run `node tools/audit/mergeGate.mjs` (or `node tools/merge.mjs <branch>`, docs/WORKFLOW.md). All rows must PASS (exit 0).
2. Run the browser gates it lists, including the **visual tour** (docs/TOUR.md): `debug/tour.html` on the branch, then
   `node tools/tour/compare.mjs foundation <run>`. Look at every flagged view and explain it in the merge message.
3. After the merge, the branch's tour run becomes the new `foundation` baseline (the old one is kept as
   `foundation-pre-<branch>`).

This page is GENERATED (`node tools/docs/rulesIndex.mjs`) from one file per rule, `docs/rules/<slug>.md`; the `meta`
gate row fails when it is stale. To add a rule: a new `docs/rules/<slug>.md` (`added:` date, `check:`, **Rule.** and
**Why.** paragraphs; no number: rules 1-48 keep theirs for history, new ones are named by slug), plus its gate row
`tools/audit/gate.d/<name>.mjs` (node, offline) or `tools/audit/gate.d/browser/<name>.mjs` (needs the viewer), then
regenerate this page. See docs/WORKFLOW.md.

| [street-invariants](rules/street-invariants.md) |  (provisional) | Street paint is judged on what the city DRAWS (the asphalt line codes and the paint decal) against the MEASURED kerb, with no exclusion zones and nothing skipped as unmeasured: an along-road stroke runs within 3 deg of the kerb tangent, its paint at least 0.10 m inside the carriageway, an edge line at kerb - 0.30 +- 0.10 m, no along-road stroke inside a junction. | [traffic-mix](rules/traffic-mix.md) |  (provisional) | The traffic is the city's real mix, by hour, day and place, never one fixed list: every vehicle class that drives in Uccle has a share per hour band from data or a stated estimate (trafMix.js `shares`: cars with ~30 % SUVs, vans ~12 % by day / ~4 % at night, taxis, the zone's police patrols - more round the station -, rare ambulances, very rare fire engines near the fire station, weekday-morning bin lorries) and the buses run as BUSES: on their real lines (OSM route relations), at their headway for the hour, stopping with the front door at their stops' poles; an emergency vehicle on a run (beacons: emissive, never a light; the siren through the sound gate) makes the traffic yield exactly as the police game's car does; a service vehicle never gets stuck (a planned stop is not a standstill), a wide body keeps off the parked cars, and the whole costs <= 10 % more per car and step. | owner playtest 2026-11-19: "I don't see much police patrol, why?" - the patrol car was filtered OUT of the traffic's type list (`carFleet.js`: the police estate was "the yard / game's"): 0 patrols, no ambulance, no bus, one weight for every type at every hour | `trafmix`: tools/audit/trafmixGate.mjs (heavy.glb budgets + kinds + wheels on the ground, the mix tables, the realised shares at 8 / 13 / 18 h, patrols x5 round Rue Rouge, buses on their lines + door-to-pole, emergency yield, stuck, cost; `--old` fails) |
